Class Dashboard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.view.gui.Dashboard
public class Dashboard extends Object
Controller for the main game dashboard during flight phase 1. Displays the player's ship, rocket positions on the track, and manages game actions such as drawing cards, viewing opponent ships, and handling player elimination or abandonment.

    • loadRockets

      public void loadRockets()
      Loads and displays rocket images on the track based on each player's position. Clears existing rocket images before loading new ones.

    • setLeader

      public void setLeader(boolean isLeader)
      Sets whether the current player is the leader and updates UI accordingly. Enables/disables the draw card button and updates the notification label.
      Parameters:
      isLeader - true if the player is the leader, false otherwise

    • showElimination

      public void showElimination(int reasonCode)
      Displays an elimination message and disables all interactive controls.
      Parameters:
      reasonCode - the code indicating the reason for elimination: 1 - engine power is 0 2 - no crew members left 3 - lapped by another player 4 - abandoned the race
